Jammu and Kashmir Assembly Sees Brawl Amidst Session

A significant commotion erupted within the Jammu and Kashmir Assembly, involving physical altercations and pushing among legislators. Ahead of the assembly session, security measures were heightened, with restrictions placed on private vehicles of employees and police entering the civil secretariat.
